detailed_descriptions.en: The life of a sacrifice isn't an easy one, but Yomi is just the woman for the job. Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, she is sent as an offering to the depths of Hell. Yomi knows it's a one-way trip, but she's not about to let that ruin things for her; if anything, she's excited. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer? In this monster-raising RPG, control Yomi as she does everything in her power to help manage the monsters of the underworld. Gather monster parts and experience to get stronger! Farm them and release the monsters back into the caverns to gain even further stats. Delve deeper and deeper, discovering all the secrets... and maybe even make a few friends along the way! Being a sacrifice isn't all bad, right? Gather and Craft! Explore and find materials to craft into useful items, then experiment with the crafting system to maximize your gameplay!
